title: GTA VI PRE-LOAD STARTS NOV 10
label: OFFICIAL ROCKSTAR NEWS
script: GTA Six pre-load starts November tenth. Here's what Rockstar has confirmed! The release is scheduled for November nineteenth, twenty twenty-six. Rockstar lists PlayStation Five and Xbox Series X and S. Keep an eye on official updates, and avoid leaked footage. So, are you playing on PlayStation or Xbox? Let us know!
